mapper.sql: select crmp_llave as key ,crmp_catalogo as catalog ,crmp_cuenta as account ,(select ccue_nombre from cuenta_ccuep where ccue_llave = crmp_cuenta) as accountName ,(select ccue_codigo from cuenta_ccuep where ccue_llave = crmp_cuenta) as accountCode ,nrmp_nivel as level ,drmp_fecha as mapDate ,nrmp_ano as year ,nrmp_mes as month ,nrmp_dia as day ,nrmp_hora as hour ,nrmp_minuto as minute ,nrmp_cantidad as quantity ,nrmp_porcentaje as percentaje ,mrmp_saldoanterior as lastBalance ,mrmp_positivo as positive ,mrmp_negativo as negative ,mrmp_valor as value ,crmp_tipo as type ,crmp_estado as state from mapa_resultados_rmp a
mapper.select: update mapa_resultados_rmp set crmp_catalogo = #{catalog}, crmp_cuenta = #{account}, nrmp_nivel = #{level}, drmp_fecha = #{mapDate}, nrmp_ano = #{year}, nrmp_mes = #{month}, nrmp_dia = #{day}, nrmp_hora = #{hour}, nrmp_minuto = #{minute}, nrmp_cantidad = #{quantity}, nrmp_porcentaje = #{percentaje}, mrmp_saldoanterior = #{lastBalance}, mrmp_positivo = #{positive}, mrmp_negativo = #{negative}, mrmp_valor = #{value}, crmp_tipo = #{type}, crmp_estado =#{state}
